analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free is caused by replacing an atom via RWMol::replaceAtom() while stale atom bookmark pointers are still kept. ParseMarvinSmartsLine creates a QueryAtom copy and calls replaceAtom(oidx,&qAt), which deletes the old Atom object. Bookmarks (used later by SGroup parsing) are not remapped to the new atom, so subsequent bookmark lookup returns a dangling Atom* and SubstanceGroup::addParentAtomWithBookmark dereferences it (getIdx), triggering UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Input must include both an MRV SMARTS property line ("M  MRV SMA ...") targeting an existing atom and later SGroup vector data that resolves atoms by bookmark (e.g. SPA/SAL processing in ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine). Data flow: MolDataStreamToMol -> ParseMolBlockProperties parses MRV line first, calls ParseMarvinSmartsLine -> replaceAtom frees original atom without fixing bookmarks -> later ParseSGroupV2000VectorDataLine calls addParentAtomWithBookmark/addAtomWithBookmark -> getUniqueAtomWithBookmark returns freed pointer -> dereference causes heap-use-after-free.
